verdict.rationale: Gram's catalog imports "official" third-party MCP servers from the official MCP Registry, which is an implicit officialness signal. A Verify step probes an endpoint with an MCP initialize request to confirm it is live before the server is created. Observability adds internal tool-call counts and tool-effectiveness metrics. None of this is a published, side-by-side comparison of servers: the liveness probe is a one-time setup check, and usage metrics reflect only the org's own traffic. Missing for 10: published usage or popularity counts in the catalog, ongoing health status per server, quality scores, explicit verification badges, and a way to compare servers on these signals.
